title: Ending Charge on a Moved Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) Certificate
content:
A transfer ending charge is added to the moved certificate fee under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44). A moved certificate is the state-change refiling a named insured orders after moving. The charge follows how the replaced certificate's backing term ended, read from the cancellation reason on that Owner Auto Policy term or Named Non-Owner Policy term.

| Cancellation reason of the replaced certificate's backing term | Transfer ending charge |
|---|---|
| nonpayment | 4.00 |
| insured request | 2.00 |
| underwriting, down payment dishonored or converted to an owner policy | none |

**Cases (hypothetical)**

- **Nonpayment.** An Owner Auto Policy term cancelled for nonpayment: 4.00.
- **Converted to an owner policy.** A Named Non-Owner Policy term cancelled as converted to an owner policy: no ending charge.
- **Down payment dishonored.** An Owner Auto Policy term cancelled because the down payment was dishonored: no ending charge.
